data.title: Bay Villas
data.about:
Immerse yourself in serenity at Bay Villas Dubai Islands by Nakheel, where opulent homes blend seamlessly with the tranquil charm of island living. Set on Island B, this low-density waterfront community offers a refined balance between coastal privacy and easy access to the city.

Prospective buyers can select from 3 to 4-bedroom townhouses, 3 to 4-bedroom semi-detached villas, 4 to 5-bedroom garden villas, and exclusive 5 to 6-bedroom beachfront and waterfront villas. Each residence at Bay Villas is meticulously designed, featuring expansive interiors, premium finishes, and thoughtfully selected fittings inspired by a “barefoot luxury” aesthetic.

Revel in an abundance of lifestyle-focused amenities at Bay Villas Nakheel, crafted for a resort-style experience. Residents enjoy private beach access, beach club, linear parks, shoreline park, clubhouse with pool, fitness areas, sports courts, play areas, seating pavilions, and barbecue zones, completing the ultimate fusion of luxury, nature, and relaxed island living.

location_tile.title: Experience an integrated and coveted island experience at Dubai Islands!
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Islands offers residents an exceptional lifestyle encompassing a vast 18 sq. km. area. This district is synonymous with luxury, featuring an impressive array of over 80 hotels and resorts, 20 km of immaculate beaches, and an array of activities, including water sports, creating an attractive destination for residents and tourists alike.

Bay Villas Nakheel is situated on Island B within this community. Island B is an exceptional resort-style islet, home to numerous residential properties, beach resorts, and marinas. Its strategic location ensures easy access to major attractions, shopping centers, entertainment venues, and the international airport.

  • 18 mins - Dubai International Airport
  • 18 mins - Burjuman
  • 25 mins - Dubai Mall
  • 26 mins - Downtown Dubai
  • 19 mins - Victoria International School
